name: implement-ticket
description: Develop one GitHub ticket without user intervention. Driver agent reads steps in order, dispatches one subagent per step, records completion in a state file.

steps.name: tdd-developer
steps.task: Implement the ticket test-first in $workdir on branch $branch
steps.done_when: targeted tests pass; changes committed with Conventional Commits footer 'Refs: #$ticket'

steps.name: code-review
steps.task: Review the last commit on Standards and Spec axes; save report to docs/reviews/

steps.name: review-developer
steps.task: Implement all findings of the code review
steps.done_when: findings resolved; tests pass; commit made

steps.name: coverage-fixer
steps.task: Raise JaCoCo coverage to 100% line/method/class and >=95% branch/instruction per class (or current if higher)

steps.name: test-hardener
steps.task: Raise Pitest mutation coverage and test strength to >=95% (or current if higher)

steps.name: test-consolidator
steps.task: Consolidate duplicate tests; keep all acceptance criteria and per-package coverage; no mutation testing
steps.done_when: full Gradle suite + CodeNarc pass; commit made
